title: retrieve_tools filter_diagnostics block (Spec 094, FR-003)
description: Present in a retrieve_tools response only when at least one annotation filter is active AND omitted at least one candidate tool. Absent otherwise (byte-identical legacy response).

matched_before_filters.description: Size of the effective candidate window that entered annotation filtering (post-search-normalization, post-visibility, no backfill).

omitted_total.description: Total tools omitted by annotation filters. Invariant: equals the sum of all reason counts, and matched_before_filters - omitted_total equals the response's total.

omitted_by_filter.description: One entry per ACTIVE filter that omitted >=1 tool. Inactive filters and active zero-count filters never appear. Serialized in alphabetical key order.

suggestion.description: Exactly one actionable string, selected by missing-cause precedence (FR-006); names only the responsible filter(s); JSON-safe ASCII subset.

missing_annotation.description: Omissions where annotations were absent/unresolvable or the decisive hint was unset.

explicit.description: Omissions where the decisive hint was explicitly unsafe (readOnlyHint=false, destructiveHint=true, openWorldHint=true).
